Starting balance — Inventory Items — Edit

This guide explains how to set up starting balances for your inventory items in Manager. The starting balance represents the quantities of inventory items at the beginning of your accounting period, including items on hand, items purchased but not yet received, and items sold but not yet delivered.

To set up starting balances, use the Starting Balance - Inventory Items - Edit form. This form includes several fields to accurately record the status of your inventory items.

1. Inventory Item

Select the inventory item for which you want to set up a starting balance. The item must already exist in the Inventory Items tab.

  • Inventory Item: Choose the specific item from your list of inventory items.

2. Quantity on Hand

If you have physical quantities of the item on hand, enable this option to record them.

  • Qty on Hand: Check this box if you have any quantity physically in your possession.

Inventory Location

Specify where the physical quantities are stored.

  • Inventory Location: Select the location where the item is physically held. This helps in tracking inventory across different storage areas.

Quantity on Hand

Enter the total quantity of the item that you currently have at the specified location.

  • Qty on Hand: Input the physical quantity available at the inventory location.

3. Quantity to Receive

If you have ordered quantities from suppliers that have not yet been delivered, enable this option.

  • Qty to Receive: Check this box if you have pending purchases that are yet to be received.

Supplier

Select the supplier from whom you are expecting the delivery.

  • Supplier: Choose the supplier that you have purchased the item from but have not yet received.

Quantity to Receive

Enter the quantity that is due to be received from the supplier.

  • Qty to Receive: Input the number of units purchased but not yet delivered by the supplier.

4. Quantity to Deliver

If you have sold quantities to customers that have not yet been delivered, enable this option.

  • Qty to Deliver: Check this box if you have pending sales that are yet to be delivered.

Customer

Select the customer who has purchased the item but has not yet received it.

  • Customer: Choose the customer awaiting delivery of the item.

Quantity to Deliver

Enter the quantity that you need to deliver to the customer.

  • Qty to Deliver: Input the number of units sold but not yet delivered to the customer.

By accurately entering these details, you ensure that your inventory records reflect the true state of your stock, pending purchases, and pending sales. This helps in effective inventory management and provides accurate financial reporting.
